 Bodhi Tree Systems invests $180 mn in Adyar Ananda Bhavan for majority stake
 Bodhi Tree Systems invests $180 mn in Adyar Ananda Bhavan for majority stake
 Uday Shankar will serve as Chairperson of A2B’s new Board of Directors 
 by
 e4m Staff
 Published: 
 Nov 12, 2026 4:33 PM 
 | 
 3 min read 
 Follow Us 
 Show Quick Read
 AI-assisted summary, reviewed by our newsroom
 ▼ 
 Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) has entered a strategic partnership with Bodhi Tree Systems, led by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar, involving a $180 million investment for a majority stake in A2B.
 The partnership aims to scale A2B, a prominent South Indian food brand, both nationally and internationally, leveraging its existing operations in markets like Singapore, the US, Australia, Malaysia, and the UK.
 Uday Shankar will assume the role of Chairperson on A2B's new Board of Directors, with plans to prepare the company for public markets and enhance its leadership, digital capabilities, and product offerings.
 This collaboration marks Bodhi Tree's third investment in consumer businesses, focusing on creating enduring social value and modernizing A2B's operations to meet global standards.
 Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) and Bodhi Tree Systems, the platform of James Murdoch’s Lupa Systems and Uday Shankar, have announced a strategic partnership to build a global champion in Indian food.  
 --> 
 --> 
 The $180 million investment by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar’s Bodhi Tree for a majority stake will help scale one of India’s most trusted food brands nationally and across the globe 
 --> 
 -->
 A2B is one of South India’s leading food brands for casual dining and packaged South Indian sweets and savouries.  
 “A2B has earned the trust of millions of families through its consistent and reliable quality,” said James Murdoch and Uday Shankar, co-founders of Bodhi Tree Systems. “We are grateful to the co-founders, K.T. Srinivasa Raja and K.T. Venkatesan, for this opportunity to partner with them to build a differentiated, professionally managed Indian food company, one that sets new standards for the sector. While A2B is a formidable brand in India, we are equally impressed by the scale and reach of its operations in Singapore, the United States, Australia, Malaysia, and the UK. We look forward to working with the team to take its authentic cuisine to a far broader global audience.”  
 Uday Shankar will serve as Chairperson of A2B’s new Board of Directors. “What began as a sweet shop started by my brother and me 50 years ago is now part of daily life for millions of families, and we are proud of every one of our people who made that possible,” said K.T. Srinivasa Raja, CoFounder, A2B.  
 “We are excited to begin this next chapter with Bodhi Tree. The plan we have built together will make A2B a company fit for the public markets, so that our customers, employees and investors can share in its future.”  
 K.T. Venkatesan, Co-Founder, A2B, said: “We are delighted to welcome Bodhi Tree as our partner. James and Uday bring deep experience in building consumer businesses at scale. Together, we look forward to creating new opportunities for our people and taking A2B into many more homes.”  
 A2B is Bodhi Tree’s third investment, after ALLEN Career Institute and JioStar.  
 Bodhi Tree partners with businesses that create enduring social value. It seeks out companies on an assured footing in consumer sectors at an inflexion point and works alongside their teams, building on the values and culture that got them there, to achieve a generational leap for the company and its sector.  
 The partnership will focus on strengthening A2B's leadership and talent, building digital capability, modernising its kitchens and manufacturing to global standards, expanding its range of healthy and nutritious food, and growing its restaurants and packaged foods across India and in international markets.
